purpose: Falsify three new cross-sectional mechanisms after repeated 2026-pass/2025-fail candidate behavior, without using 2025 data for discovery or selection.

data.survivorship_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; historical results do not remove survivorship risk.
data.temporal_holdout_protection: No 2025 market data may be inspected or used for Sprint 7 family selection. Any new candidate must face a separately frozen non-overlapping 2025 D3 after candidate freeze.

execution.execution: next UTC daily open after completed signal day

vol_adjusted_short_term_reversal.hypothesis: A one-day idiosyncratic-sized move relative to the asset's strictly prior realized volatility partially mean reverts cross-sectionally over the next daily period.
vol_adjusted_short_term_reversal.score: negative completed close-to-close return at t divided by sample standard deviation of strictly prior completed returns t-N through t-1
vol_adjusted_short_term_reversal.direction: long highest two scores and short lowest two scores
vol_adjusted_short_term_reversal.principal_control: exact reversed direction, equivalent to normalized short-term continuation

momentum_acceleration.hypothesis: Assets whose recent N-day cumulative return is improving versus the immediately preceding N-day cumulative return exhibit next-day cross-sectional continuation.
momentum_acceleration.score: sum completed close-to-close returns over t-N+1 through t minus sum over t-2N+1 through t-N
momentum_acceleration.direction: long highest two scores and short lowest two scores

upside_downside_beta_asymmetry.hypothesis: Alts with stronger realized beta to BTC on BTC-up days than on BTC-down days exhibit superior relative continuation into the next daily period.
upside_downside_beta_asymmetry.score: OLS slope versus BTC on positive-BTC days minus OLS slope versus BTC on negative-BTC days over the most recent N completed returns ending at t; intercept included separately in each subset
upside_downside_beta_asymmetry.portfolio_universe: nine alts only; BTC is factor and receives zero target weight
upside_downside_beta_asymmetry.direction: long highest two alt scores and short lowest two alt scores

family_falsification_gate.selection_if_family_passes: Among variants belonging to an adjacent 1.5x-cost-positive neighborhood, select the upper median parameter; never select by maximum PnL.

evidence_boundary.positive_sprint_result_only_allows: new frozen candidate followed by independent reproduction, different-source D2, separately frozen non-overlapping temporal D3, and prospective D4
